style: Bright, cheerful marching band characters. Children of many different skin tones and hair styles. Front view, standing straight at attention, same size and pose for every musician so they line up neatly.

assets.name: drum
assets.prompt: A girl with dark brown skin and curly black hair in puffs, red band uniform with gold braid and white cross straps, a small white snare drum held high against her chest, holding drumsticks. Tall black shako hat with gold trim and a plume. Full length portrait: the whole child from the top of the plume down to the shoes, nothing cut off, with empty space above the plume and below the shoes. Standing at attention facing the viewer, feet a little apart with a clear gap between the two legs, navy trousers with a gold side stripe, black shoes. The instrument is held up at chest height so both legs are fully visible below it.
